output.reason: The linked PR [ev-be7b495ffc4a] says the fix makes a taint with no value keep a leading colon before its effect in Bottlerocket settings, and that without it the Bottlerocket instance cannot register with the cluster. Upgrading therefore fixes a failure; nothing new breaks, so behavior-change with low severity (review) is right. The proposed statement is too broad: it says all tainted Bottlerocket nodes get a different format, but the fix covers only taints with no value. The changed files [ev-586dee25060d] are limited to the Bottlerocket bootstrap code and its userdata golden files.

correction.statement: Karpenter 1.0.0 changes how Bottlerocket userdata renders a taint with no value: it now keeps a leading colon before the effect. With the old format, such Bottlerocket instances could not register with the cluster.

consequence.statement: After the upgrade, Karpenter writes Bottlerocket taints that have no value with a leading colon before the effect. Bottlerocket nodes with such taints can now register with the cluster; under the old format they could not. Nothing that worked before stops working.
consequence.remediation: After upgrading, check that Bottlerocket nodes with value-less taints register and carry the expected taints.
